newsitem.title: USA: New Mexico 250 MW coal unit starts maintenance Fri.
newsitem.headline: New Mexico 250 MW coal unit starts maintenance Fri.

text.p: The 250 megawatt Plains Escalante Generating Station (PEGS) in northern New Mexico will begin a scheduled maintenance shutdown late Friday night, a spokesman for Plains Electric Generation and Transmission Cooperative said Wednesday.
The outage of the coal-fired unit is expected to last five weeks, said spokesman Mike McInnes.
The PEGS unit undergoes maintenance work every 18 months, but that will be extended to 24-month cycles starting in 1998, he added.
Traders in the region did not expect the shutdown to have much impact on the power market due to the fairly small capacity of the unit.
